description_en: Located on the 4th floor of Siam Paragon in the EATELIER dining area 🌙 BlueMoon.bkk is famous for its cocktails and operates daily until midnight, making it the perfect nighttime spot after shopping around the Siam area. You can call 085-518-2264 to make a reservation.
description_zh: 位於 Siam Paragon 4 樓 EATELIER 美食區 🌙 BlueMoon.bkk 以調酒聞名，每日營業至午夜，是逛完暹羅商圈後的夜間落腳選擇。備有電話 085-518-2264 可預約。
address: 4th floor Eatelier zone, Siam Paragon, แขวงปทุมวัน เขตปทุมวัน กรุงเทพมหานคร 10330, Thailand

description_en:
Please note that the information shows Nam Yoi is located in Phuket, not Bangkok. The introduction below is written according to the format:

A local institution on Phuket Island that's been operating for over 30 years 🐌, Nam Yoi is renowned for its authentic Southern Thai cuisine and has earned recognition from the Michelin Bib Gourmand. The signature river snail curry boasts intense flavors, and many dishes skew toward the spicy side — we'd recommend letting the staff know your heat preference when ordering. The menu centers around large plates of white rice paired with various Southern Thai home-style dishes, with outdoor seating available for both lunch and dinner service.
description_zh:
請注意，資料顯示 Nam Yoi 位於普吉島（Phuket），並非曼谷。以下仍依格式撰寫介紹：

開業逾 30 年的普吉島在地老店 🐌 以正宗南泰料理聞名，獲 Michelin Bib Gourmand 肯定。招牌河螺咖哩風味濃烈，許多菜色辣度偏高，點餐時建議向店員說明喜好。菜單以大盤白飯配多款南泰家常菜為核心，戶外座位，午晚餐皆有供應。
address: 63 250 Thanon Rumpattana, Tambon Ratsada, Amphoe Mueang Phuket, Chang Wat Phuket 83000, Thailand

name_en: แซ่บ by ส. ขอนแก่น
name_zh: แซ่บ by ส. ขอนแก่น
description_en: แซ่บ by ส.ขอนแก่น 🌶️ A Northeast Thai cuisine chain created by the renowned Khon Kaen brand, specializing in green papaya salad and grilled chicken, with their signature fish sauce dishes that are rich and deeply flavorful. They offer an all-you-can-eat buffet option so you can eat to your heart's content without limits. Currently they have five branches in Bangkok including EmQuartier and Seacon Square. Authentic Northeast Thai flavors brought right into the shopping malls—affordable and super convenient.
description_zh: แซ่บ by ส.ขอนแก่น 🌶️ 由知名孔敬品牌打造的東北泰料理連鎖，主打青木瓜沙拉與烤雞，招牌魚醬料理濃郁夠味。設有自助餐方案讓你狂嗑不限量，目前在曼谷有 EmQuartier、Seacon Square 等五個分店。道地東北泰口味搬進商場，平價又方便。
address: 55 Thanon Srinagarindra, Khwaeng Nong Bon, Khet Prawet, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10250, Thailand

name_en: แซ่บ by ส. ขอนแก่น
name_zh: แซ่บ by ส. ขอนแก่น
description_en: แซ่บ by ส.ขอนแก่น 🌶️ This is a northeastern Thai cuisine branch from the famous Khon Kaen restaurant ส.ขอนแก่น, specializing in green papaya salad and various Isan dishes with bold, robust fish sauce flavors. They offer all-you-can-eat buffet options starting from just a hundred baht, where you can feast on grilled chicken and the entire tom yum series to your heart's content. Currently operating at five shopping malls including EmQuartier and Seacon Square, it's perfect for gathering friends and digging in with gusto.
description_zh: แซ่บ by ส.ขอนแก่น 🌶️ 來自孔敬名店 ส.ขอนแก่น 的東北菜支線，主打青木瓜沙拉與各式伊善料理，魚醬風味濃郁夠勁。設有百元起跳的自助餐方案，烤雞、冬蔭系列一次吃到飽，目前在 EmQuartier、Seacon Square 等五個商場設有分店，適合呼朋引伴大口開吃。
address: 55 Thanon Srinagarindra, Khwaeng Nong Bon, Khet Prawet, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10250, Thailand

description_en: Tucked away on the 32nd floor of Millennium Hilton Bangkok in the Khlong San district 🌃 — 360-degree panoramic views sweeping across the Chao Phraya River and Bangkok's skyline, sipping cocktails under live jazz performances, with pricing that's way more reasonable than other rooftop bars in this category. Opens from 5 PM onwards, romantic lighting combined with flawless night views, it's genuinely the most worthwhile drink you can have at the top of any riverside venue on the west bank.
description_zh: 藏身 Khlong San 區 Millennium Hilton Bangkok 32 樓 🌃 三百六十度全景俯瞰昭披耶河與曼谷天際線，現場爵士樂演奏下小酌調酒，比同級空中酒吧定價更親民。傍晚 17:00 開始營業，浪漫燈光加上無死角夜景，是河岸西岸最值得登頂的一杯。
address: 123 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Khwaeng Khlong Ton Sai, Khet Khlong San, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10600, Thailand

description_en: Located in the Khlong San district right next to ICONSIAM, this five-star riverside landmark 🌆 features ThreeSixty bar and Jazz Lounge on the top floor with panoramic views of the Chao Phraya River, complete with live jazz performances and craft cocktails every night. Flow restaurant comes highly recommended for breakfast, and the dinner buffet features Italian crispy pork belly, snow crab, imported oysters and an impressive seafood spread, plus there's an eforea Spa for guests to unwind.
description_zh: 坐落 Khlong San 區、緊鄰 ICONSIAM 的五星河畔地標 🌆 頂樓 ThreeSixty 酒吧與爵士廊將昭披耶河全景盡收眼底，每晚搭配現場爵士演出與手工調酒。Flow 餐廳早餐口碑極佳，自助晚餐含義式脆皮豬五花、雪場蟹、進口生蠔等海鮮陣容，另設 eforea Spa 供住客放鬆。
address: 123 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Khwaeng Khlong Ton Sai, Khet Khlong San, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10600, Thailand

description_en: Located at 48 Khao San Road, 9 Bar is one of the rare outdoor party bars on this backpacker street 🎵 It specializes in Techno music and opens from 6 PM every night until late, with events on Wednesdays too. The overall vibe has a vintage 1960s old house atmosphere, with the sound level a bit lower than the main street, and live music performances every night. You need to bring your ID if you're 20 years old or above to enter.
description_zh: 位於考山路 48 號，9 Bar 是這條背包客街上少見的戶外派對酒吧 🎵 主打 Techno 音樂，每晚 18:00 開到深夜，週三亦有活動。整體風格帶復古 60 年代老宅氛圍，音量比主街稍低，每晚有現場音樂演出。20 歲以上需帶身份證入場。
address: 48 Thanon Khao San, Khwaeng Talat Yot, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: Located at MahaNakhon CUBE on the 6th floor of Silom Soi 9 🍸 This concept restaurant bar named after a fashion magazine features a terrace decorated in 1920s style, serving the signature small bites "Vogue Lounge Bites" designed by Chef Cyril Cocconi, paired with craft cocktails and live music, open daily from 5 PM to midnight.
description_zh: 位於 Silom Soi 9 摩天樓 MahaNakhon CUBE 6 樓 🍸 這間以時尚雜誌命名的概念餐廳酒吧，露台以 20 年代裝潢佈置，提供主廚 Cyril Cocconi 設計的招牌小食「Vogue Lounge Bites」，搭配精緻調酒與現場音樂，每日下午 5 時營業至午夜。
address: MahaNakhon CUBE 96 Thanon Naradhiwat Rajanagarindra, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

name_en: You & I Premium Suki Buffet - Central World
name_zh: You & I Premium Suki Buffet - Central World
description_en: Located in Central World is an all-you-can-eat hot pot restaurant 🍲 that specializes in excellent value premium sets. The ingredients lineup includes three cuts of Wagyu beef (Wagyu Biscuit, short plate, and regular Wagyu), Japanese scallops, Iberian pork, black pork, and Japanese raw eggs. You can choose from spicy and numbing, black broth, or pork bone for your soup base, and dessert is included after the meal. Per person it costs 501–1,000 Thai baht — perfect if you want to enjoy a carefully curated hot pot experience in the city center.
description_zh: 位於 Central World 的火鍋吃到飽餐廳 🍲 主打超值頂級套餐，食材陣容包含和牛三種部位（Wagyu Biscuit、短板、普通和牛）、日本帆立貝、伊比利豬、黑毛豬及日本生雞蛋，湯底可選麻辣、黑湯或豬骨，餐後另附甜點，人均消費 501–1,000 泰銖，適合想在市中心吃一頓講究鍋物的旅客。
address: เลขที่ 4, 4/1-4/2, โซน Isetan เก่า, ชั้น 6 โซน BeacOnzOne, 4, 4 ถ. ราชดำริ แขวงปทุมวัน เขตปทุมวัน กรุงเทพมหานคร 10330, Thailand

description_en: MK's upscale brand flagship location right at Siam Paragon 🍲 specializing in Chinese hotpot, with must-order signatures including Sichuan sauce-mixed rice noodles, Peking duck, and wagyu in black pepper sauce—basically every table gets these. The restaurant positioning is way more upscale than your typical MK, with a much more refined atmosphere. Per person you're looking at around 400–800 baht, and it's most worth it when you're sharing dishes with a group.
description_zh: MK 旗下高端品牌，首店就落在 Siam Paragon 🍲 主打中式火鍋路線，招牌必點包括四川醬拌河粉、北京烤鴨及黑椒汁和牛，幾乎每桌必點。餐廳定位比一般 MK 升級，氛圍更精緻，人均消費約 400–800 泰銖，多人分菜最划算。
address: 991/1 สยามพารากอน Rama I Rd, Khwaeng Pathum Wan, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: MK upscale sukiyaki hot pot chain 🍲 Located in Bang Rak, offering three all-you-can-eat plans — the Basic at 299 baht includes unlimited seafood, Premium at 699 baht features over 150 dishes highlighting meat and seafood, and the flagship Ultimate at 899 baht adds unlimited Japanese wagyu, Australian wagyu, and signature MK roasted duck, with a 2-hour time limit, plus complimentary refills on beverages, sauces, and broth.
description_zh: MK 連鎖壽喜鍋的高階版本 🍲 位於 Bang Rak，提供三檔吃到飽方案——基本款 299 泰銖含無限海鮮，Premium 699 泰銖主打肉類與海鮮逾 150 道菜，旗艦 Ultimate 899 泰銖則加入日本和牛、澳洲和牛及招牌 MK 烤鴨無限享用，限時 2 小時，茶飲、醬料、湯底皆免費續加。
address: 118 Thanon Sala Daeng, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: Thailand's longstanding sukiyaki chain 🍲 Located on the 7th floor of Central World mall, it specializes in light Thai-style hot pot. Must-try signature dishes include roasted duck, MK hand-crafted fish balls, and jade noodles, plus a selection of dim sum, fried squid, and various rice and noodle dishes. Per person spending is around 251–500 baht, perfect for gathering the whole family for a meal after shopping, with wallet-friendly prices and spacious surroundings.
description_zh: 泰國連鎖壽喜燒老字號 🍲 位於 Central World 商場 7 樓，主打清淡泰式火鍋，招牌必點烤鴨、MK 手工魚蛋與翡翠麵，另有點心、炸魷魚與各式單品飯麵可選。人均消費約 251–500 泰銖，適合逛街後全家聚餐填肚，價格親民、環境寬敞。
address: B716 7th floor, 999/9 Rama I Rd, Khwaeng Pathum Wan, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, top-rated restaurant in Bangkok. Known for Pad Thai and Mango Sticky Rice.
description_zh: 藏在 Sukhumvit Soi 11 的戶外泰式餐廳酒吧 🌿 主打泰式炒河粉、芒果糯米飯與調酒，菜單選擇豐富、評分高達 4.8 分。每日下午 4 點開到凌晨 3 點，開放空間氣氛熱鬧，適合夜間聚餐消遣。電話 064-931-1393。
address: 20 Soi Sukhumvit 11, Khwaeng Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, highly praised restaurant in Bangkok. Known for Tom Yum and Everything right.
description_zh: 藏身 Sukhumvit 21 巷內的泰菜隱店 🌶️ 主廚 Max 走遍泰北、泰南與依善取經，將各地村落家常菜帶回曼谷。招牌 Tom Yum 辣勁紮實，Yum 系涼拌料理爽口夠味，芒果糯米飯用新鮮芒果現做，每逢用餐時段常需排隊入場。每日午餐至晚餐營業。
address: 139/1 Soi Sukhumvit 21 (Asoke Soi 1 sub-district, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, highly praised restaurant in Bangkok. Known for Massaman Curry and Steak.
description_zh: 位於 Sukhumvit Soi 8、BTS Nana 4號出口步行200公尺 🦋 2006年創立的當代泰式料理，主打 Massaman Curry、牛排與調酒，以創意手法重新詮釋經典泰味，並精選法國等地葡萄酒搭配。螃蟹料理食材份量紮實、蟹味濃郁獲好評。室內可容150人、附戶外露台，每日中午12點營業至深夜11點。
address: 43 Soi Sukhumvit 8, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khet Khlong Toei, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, top-rated restaurant in Bangkok. Known for Pasta.
description_zh: 藏身 Saladaeng 鬧區的手工義大利麵專門店 🍝 招牌菜包括淋上是拉差辣醬的溫泉蛋卡波納拉，以及奶油鮮蝦白醬義大利麵，走義式融合路線。每人均消約 251–500 泰銖，風格溫馨居家，加收 5% 服務費，也有 Line 集點回饋，Central World 7 樓設有分店。
address: บ้านเค เรสซิเดนซ์, 12/1 ชั้นที่ 2 Soi Sathon 2, Si Lom, Khet Sathon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, top-rated restaurant in Bangkok. Known for Larb.
description_zh: 位於 Ari 區 La Villa 商場三樓的伊森料理餐廳 🌶️ 主打正宗東北泰菜，招牌有 Larb 肉末沙拉、ตำข้าวโพดไข่เค็ม（鹹蛋玉米青木瓜沙拉）、炸雞翅與蒜香炸雞軟骨。每天 11:00–22:00 營業，BTS Ari 站步行可達，是逛街中途補充泰北東部風味的實惠選擇。
address: 3rd Floor, 356 Phahon Yothin Road, Khwaeng Samsen Nai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, top-rated restaurant in Bangkok. Known for Dim Sum.
description_zh: 來自清邁的點心名店 🍵 Kopihub Prime 在 Ari Soi 2 開設曼谷旗艦店，老宅改造的空間兼具復古與精緻感。招牌湯頭以13種中藥材燉豬骨逾6小時，滋味醇厚層次分明。點心、茶、咖啡一應俱全，緊鄰 BTS Ari 站，門前備有停車位，午餐或輕鬆晚餐皆宜。
address: 33 Soi Ari 2, Phaya Thai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, top-rated restaurant in Bangkok.
description_zh: 位於 Ari Samphan 巷內的有機健康餐廳 🌱 菜單標示清晰，涵蓋純素選項，招牌有泰式花生醬素肉排、豆腐腰果香茅沙拉、無麩質披薩，冰咖啡與果昔也備受好評。每人消費約 501–1,000 泰銖，每日 08:00–20:00 營業，評價高達 4.9 顆星。
address: 68/1 Soi Ari Samphan 1, Phaya Thai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, highly praised restaurant in Bangkok. Known for Mango Sticky Rice and Dim Sum.
description_zh: 耀華力路（Yaowarat）的夜晚屬於這片街市 🥭 攤販沿路綿延，芒果糯米飯、點心、巴東果（Patonggo）是必試招牌。部分攤位設有冷氣室內座位，服務親切。建議10PM前抵達，因許多街邊攤約在此時陸續收攤。人潮熙攘，適合邊走邊吃、順道感受曼谷華人街的煙火氣。
address: 148 Maha Chak Rd, Khwaeng Chakkrawat, Khet Samphanthawong, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10100, Thailand

name_en: เจ๊เฮียง อาหารตามสั่ง เยาวราช Hiang A-la-carte Street Food
name_zh: เจ๊เฮียง อาหารตามสั่ง เยาวราช Hiang A-la-carte Street Food
description_en: A mid-range, well-regarded restaurant in Bangkok. Known for Food section.
description_zh: 位於耀華力路418號唐人街核心地帶 🍳 เจ๊เฮียง是一間泰式快炒小館，主打อาหารตามสั่ง（單點家常料理），菜單涵蓋各式炒飯、炒麵與下飯小炒。地址在Soi Yaowaphanit巷口附近，是當地人解決一餐的實在選擇，適合逛完耀華力夜市後填飽肚子。
address: 418 Yaowarat Rd, Khwaeng Samphanthawong, Khet Samphanthawong, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10100, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, highly praised restaurant in Bangkok. Known for Pad Thai and Chinese style noodles.
description_zh: 位於唐人街核心地帶的街頭美食攤 🍜 以泰式炒河粉與中式湯麵為招牌，其中泰式炒河粉評價略有分歧，但整體口碑不俗。另有獲 GSB Street Food 競賽推薦的打拋牛肉，以牛肉嫩度見長。查圖查週末市集設有分店，適合逛市集時順道一試。
address: 289 Yaowarat Rd, Khwaeng Samphanthawong, Khet Samphanthawong, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10100, Thailand

name_en: China town street food ( good noodle soup )
name_zh: China town street food ( good noodle soup )
description_en: A mid-range, well-regarded restaurant in Bangkok. Known for Mango Sticky Rice.
description_zh: 曼谷唐人街耀華力路的靈魂就藏在街頭小攤裡 🍜 傍晚時分攤販沿街展開，建議從Wat Mangkorn捷運站步行入內，避開週一。豬骨湯底熬得清甜醇厚，米粉吸飽湯汁，是本地人回頭率極高的日常滋味，邊走邊吃才是唐人街正確打開方式。
address: 339 Song Sawat Rd, Khwaeng Samphanthawong, Khet Samphanthawong, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10100, Thailand

name_en: Vela Bhirom Restaurant - ร้านอาหารเวฬาภิรมย์
name_zh: Vela Bhirom Restaurant - ร้านอาหารเวฬาภิรมย์
description_en: A mid-range, highly praised restaurant in Bangkok.
description_zh: 藏身沙吞 Soi 1 精品酒店 Villa Deva 內的泰式 Fine Dining 🍽️ Vela Bhirom 以「餐桌藝術」（Art de la Table）為理念，精選頂級食材詮釋正統泰國料理。訂位請撥 +66 2821 3888。
address: 88 Soi Sathon 1, Khwaeng Thung Maha Mek, Khet Sathon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10120, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, top-rated restaurant in Bangkok. Known for Steak and Espresso.
description_zh: 藏在 Sathon 區 Saphan Khu 小巷的 48 號 🥩 主打「Fine Dining 版家常菜」概念，招牌涵蓋牛排、濃縮咖啡與調酒。餐廳開放攜寵入場，每日中午 12 點營業至深夜 11 點，全年無休。義式料理底蘊加上細膩擺盤，讓熟悉的家常滋味換上精緻外衣上桌。
address: 48 Soi Saphan Khu, Khwaeng Thung Maha Mek, Khet Sathon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10120, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, top-rated restaurant in Bangkok. Known for A lowkey and Her english.
description_zh: 藏在 Soi Thoet Thai 26 巷底的三層樓餐酒館 🛕 最大賣點是可以直面大佛寺（Wat Pak Nam）的開闊露台，咖啡館從早上 9 點開始營業，廚房 11:30 開餐，頂樓酒吧下午 1 點開到晚上 10 點。菜單含素食選項，老闆娘英文流利，找位置記得停車在巷口老市場或旁邊的寺廟。

description_en: A mid-range, highly praised restaurant in Bangkok. Known for Green Curry and Mango Sticky Rice.
